nozzle_000069.label: kernel-bug
nozzle_000069.note: geometry matches (vol/area/com/bbox ok) but validate reports LOOP_SELF_INTERSECT on the 0.09 mm-wide annulus left where the bore cutter ends inside the cone wall; the ground-truth STEP trips the same check on import. ck-check wire.rs samples each coedge at 8 points, so near-concentric loops closer than the chord sag falsely cross.

tapered_boss_000256.label: kernel-gap
tapered_boss_000256.note: chamfer on the plane/B-spline edge of the lofted side is blendUnsupported (F9); the hole-rim chamfer alone works. Loft itself is exact (unchamfered volume equals the closed-form frustum to 4e-8).

twisted_drill_000546.label: kernel-gap
twisted_drill_000546.note: no twist on extrude/sweep (twistExtrude); translated as a straight extrude of the same flute section, so volume and com match but area (2.8% low) and bbox (flutes do not rotate) cannot.

coil_spring_000026.label: kernel-gap
coil_spring_000026.skip: regen does not finish in 50 s (union of the 2nd helical sweep with the 1st never returns)
coil_spring_000026.skipStep: importStep of the ground-truth STEP (spline-swept torus-like coils) does not finish in 60 s
coil_spring_000026.note: variable-pitch helix needs a 3D spline sweep path (sketch paths are planar lines/arcs, helix is constant pitch) -> translated as three constant-pitch helix sweeps; their union (adjacent end caps, overlapping coils since pitch 6 < wire dia 6.94) hangs (kernel-bug: boolean of coil sweeps does not terminate); importStep of the ground truth also hangs.

torsion_spring_000054.label: kernel-gap
torsion_spring_000054.skip: regen does not finish in 50 s (a single 12-turn helix sweep takes 19 s, union with a leg never returns)
torsion_spring_000054.note: leg workplanes are rotated 2.8 deg about X (refPlane mode angle/axis is parsed but every mode behaves as offset), so the legs are built along the untilted normal; additionally the 12-turn helix sweep alone takes 19 s and its union with a coaxial-end leg hangs (kernel-bug perf/hang). Ground truth is two disjoint solids (multi-body result).

pipe_elbow_000012.label: kernel-gap
pipe_elbow_000012.note: sweep along a multi-piece path (line-arc-line) is TODO(rebuild) in ck-model sweep (F3) -> F5 then nothingToCut.

duct_elbow_000181.label: kernel-gap
duct_elbow_000181.note: same: sweep along a multi-piece path (line-arc-line) is TODO(rebuild) (F3); F5 nothingToCut.

i_beam_000007.label: kernel-bug
i_beam_000007.note: F6 booleanFailed: the 2.175 mm hole whose axis lies in the beam end-face plane (half hole through flanges and web) fails; the full hole at z=120.84 alone is fine. Everything else (chamfer, fillet, full hole) is exact: the volume is off by exactly the half-hole.

torus_link_000095.label: kernel-gap
torus_link_000095.note: lugs touch the torus in a single point, so the union is two disjoint solids (ground truth: solids=2). Our feature union returns only the second body (volume 2548 = lugs only; torus silently dropped, no error): no multi-body result for a union of disjoint/point-contact bodies. The internal blind cross holes (void shells) are not reached.

dome_cap_000212.label: kernel-bug
dome_cap_000212.note: revolving an arc whose centre lies on the axis builds a degenerate torus (major radius 0) instead of a sphere: volume is right (389600) but the face is missing from the mesh/box/area (area 4693 vs 33426, box ends at the cylinder); the 4-hole through cut then fails (F6 booleanFailed). STEP import of the ground truth: unsupported 'single boundary winding a revolution surface' (sphere pole).

bellows_000367.label: kernel-bug
bellows_000367.note: F5/F7 booleanFailed: 6-hole bolt-circle cuts through the end flanges. Probed: the cylinders cross the conical convolution flank (F5, parallel-axis cylinder x cone) and the six-circle tool fails at the flat end too (F7) while a single circle passes; also fails with holes inside the rim radius, so the rim break-out is not the cause.

u_channel_000058.label: kernel-gap
u_channel_000058.note: F7 blendUnsupported: chamfer of a planar face edge that meets a fillet cylinder tangentially. Probed: the 4 end-edge chamfers (plane x plane) alone succeed, any single chamfer on a plane/fillet-cylinder edge fails. Box, slot and the 8-edge |Z fillet are exact.

spline_hub_000030.label: kernel-bug
spline_hub_000030.note: geometry matches (vol/area/com/bbox ok); validate reports LOOP_SELF_INTERSECT on the groove disc caps (F8.C0/C1): the r=40.15 circle lies 1 mm from the 100-arc spline loop, the known ck-check wire.rs 8-point chord-sag false positive. The ground-truth STEP trips the same check.

eyebolt_000265.label: kernel-bug
eyebolt_000265.note: F12 booleanFailed: union of the revolved torus (exact alone, V=189575) with the collar/neck/shank (torus x coaxial cylinders and cone, torus tube crossing the shank axis region). The torus overlaps the shank, so the boolean has torus x cylinder and torus x plane intersections.

pan_head_screw_000035.label: ground-truth-mismatch
pan_head_screw_000035.note: everything but the thread is exact (unthreaded 1492.07 mm3). Our swept V-groove removes 24.07 mm3 (= groove area 0.0924 mm2 x centroid path length, the geometric truth); the dataset's sweep (isFrenet=False, profile plane not exactly normal to the helix) only removes 10.08 mm3 (cause not determined), so the ground truth is not the geometric groove and cannot be matched.

nozzle_000069.label: kernel-bug
nozzle_000069.note: LOOP_SELF_INTERSECT x2 on the ground-truth STEP (same ck-check wire.rs 8-point sampling false positive as the regen side).

spline_hub_000030.label: kernel-bug
spline_hub_000030.note: LOOP_SELF_INTERSECT x2 on the ground-truth STEP: groove-disc loop 1 mm from the 100-arc spline loop (ck-check wire.rs sampling false positive).

t_pipe_fitting_000075.label: kernel-bug
t_pipe_fitting_000075.note: ground-truth STEP imports with the right volume/area/bbox but validate reports EDGE_OFF_SURFACE x2 (cylinder x cylinder branch edges after STEP import).

pan_head_screw_000035.label: kernel-bug
pan_head_screw_000035.note: validate on the imported ground-truth STEP: SHELL_NONMANIFOLD + EDGE_OFF_SURFACE (helical thread faces); also the thread volume differs from our regen (see regen cause).

dome_cap_000212.label: kernel-gap
dome_cap_000212.note: importStep: unsupported 'single boundary winding a revolution surface' (a sphere pole boundary) - same degenerate sphere-as-revolution case as the regen side.

eyebolt_000265.label: kernel-bug
eyebolt_000265.note: importStep returns a body without the torus eye (bbox x +-35 instead of +-63, volume short): torus surface in the STEP is dropped silently.

torus_link_000095.label: kernel-gap
torus_link_000095.note: ground-truth STEP holds two disjoint solids; importStep keeps one body (box shows the lug+partial only): no multi-solid import.

torsion_spring_000054.label: kernel-gap
torsion_spring_000054.note: ground-truth STEP holds two solids; importStep returns a single small solid (9% of the volume): no multi-solid import.

coil_spring_000026.label: kernel-bug
coil_spring_000026.note: importStep of the ground-truth STEP (spline-swept coil, 5 faces) does not return within 60 s.
